artworks.title: College Henri IV
artworks.medium: graphite with red chalk additions on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch depicting an architectural scene with a Gothic-style tower to the left. A hill and buildings are visible in the background. The drawing shows delicate and precise line work in soft pencil against an off-white paper background. Handwritten annotations at the top indicate the year 1883.

artworks.title: College Henri IV
artworks.medium: graphite with red chalk additions on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing displays a village scene with buildings on the left. The horizon line is suggested by the alignment of rooftops. The sketch is in pencil with fine lines defining the structures, with touches of orange for detail. The color palette is minimal, mostly natural tones and grey with sparse orange accents. Some vegetation and trees are sketched in the foreground. Various rooftops and buildings are outlined more densely in the background. The top of the paper includes inscriptions, annotations, and a faint sketch of two circular shapes.

artworks.title: Boats on River with Masts
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil sketch of a waterfront scene. Boats are shown at different distances from the viewer, with the horizon high on the page. Faint outlines of structures hint at buildings on the horizon. The boats are intricately detailed with precise lines, while the overall style is subtle and precise, using fine pencil strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray.

artworks.title: La Panne
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed pencil sketch of a ship with two masts, viewed from the side. The drawing provides a clear representation of the ship's structure. The horizon is not distinct, focusing on the ship and the water around it. The sea surface is depicted with wavy lines. The drawing style features precise pencil strokes, detailing the ship's sails, rigging, and hull. The color scheme is monochrome, with shades of gray and black. The sails are partly deployed, and the rigging's complexity is illustrated. The water is represented with curved lines, suggesting light waves. The composition highlights the ship's design and the pencil technique used.

artworks.title: Seated Female Figure for "San Francisco"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining figure beside a pedestal. The image features a sketch of a figure lying down, leaning against a small column or pedestal. The figure appears to be draped in loose fabric, with delicate lines suggesting folds and contours of the material. Behind the figure, there are faint lines hinting at additional forms or structures. The background is plain. The letters "S A S M" are inscribed in faint writing on the pedestal or nearby surface.

artworks.title: Seated Male Figure for "San Francisco"
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a person sitting, with one knee raised and an arm resting on it. The person's other arm is extended behind them. The facial features are minimally detailed, and the hair is sketched with simple strokes. The person appears to be minimally clothed with drapery. The background includes architectural elements like a column or ledge, and the word 'CISCO' is partially visible. The sketch is done with light strokes on a beige paper.

artworks.title: Moliere's Tomb
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mechanical or architectural sketches on aged paper. Various line drawings, shapes, and notations are present throughout the image. The upper left corner contains a flame-like figure, while the top center shows a dome shape with a spout. Horizontal and vertical lines intersect on the page, and there are additional light sketches and hatchings for shading. The simple lines and smudged shading suggest an early conceptual design phase.

artworks.title: Couverture du "Voyage à la nouvelle Zélande" (Cover for the Set of Etchings Entitled "A Voyage to New Zealand")
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a title page for a historical maritime voyage. The image contains intricate line drawings that form an elaborate border around the text. The central text details a voyage to New Zealand, specifically an expedition entitled "Voyage à la Nouvelle Zélande," accomplished between the years 1842 and 1846 onboard the Navire Rhin. The text also mentions command under Captain A. Bérard. The surrounding border includes nautical and exploratory themes, such as depictions of native plant leaves, a fish, and nautical equipment. There is also a strong sense of design symmetry in the illustrated border, which features stylized flora and fauna and includes a date marked as 1866. The paper has a vintage appearance consistent with the historical context of the document's content.

artworks.title: Couverture du "Voyage à la nouvelle Zélande" (Cover for the Set of Etchings Entitled "A Voyage to New Zealand")
artworks.description: The image displays ornate lines and shapes forming an intricate border with swirling, ribbon-like designs. The top section features a wavy line pattern intertwining with small bird-like shapes, resembling architectural columns. At the bottom, fish-like forms are present on either side with stylized waves. The central area is largely plain, with an oval shape hinting at a mirror or frame. The abstract composition resembles a theater stage set with elements reminiscent of maritime motifs and ancient architecture.

artworks.title: Plan du Combat de Sinope (Plan of the Battle of Sinope)
artworks.medium: etching with watercolor additions on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical chart or map of a maritime battle or event near a coastal town labeled "Sinope." The drawing shows a detailed map of a coastal area with several ships marked in the water, positioned at various distances from the shore. The coastline is outlined with distinct bends, and the city of Sinope is depicted with rectangles and polygons, possibly indicating buildings or fortifications. Next to the city are markings representing ruins and a labeled area potentially showing a lake or inland water body. Alongside the map are labels and notes in French, listing ships identified by letters such as A, B, C, etc., with associated notes on their types or states. A compass rose is included for navigational reference, and depth lines illustrated by dashed lines show changes in seabed depth.

artworks.title: Entrée du Couvent des Capucins français à Athenes (Entrance to the French Capuchin Convent at Athens)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of architectural ruins with two figures walking through an arched doorway. The focus is on intricate architectural details, including a columned structure with elaborate carvings on the right and a tall stone archway on the left. The etching technique uses fine lines and cross-hatching to depict texture and depth. The color palette is dark sepia tones, emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: Chevet de St. Martin-sur-Renelle (The Apsis of the Church of St. Martin-sur-Renelle)
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural drawing of the chevet of St. Martin sur Renelle, a parish church. The drawing highlights the Gothic style of the church with high-arched windows and ornate tracery. Fine cross-hatching is used to depict shadows and textures on the church's stonework. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of sepia and brown. Cloud formations are included on the left side of the drawing.

artworks.title: Porte d'un ancien couvent, Rue Mirabeau, à Bourges (Doorway of an Ancient Convent, in the Rue Mirabeau, Bourges)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Japanese wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gothic-style architectural doorway. The image depicts an ornate arched entrance with intricately detailed carvings surrounding the frame. The arch has a pointed peak characteristic of Gothic architecture, and there are wooden or stone columns supporting the structure. The entrance features steps leading up to it, and there are rectangular panels flanking the door. The drawing is done in a monochromatic scheme using pen and ink, with fine lines adding texture and shading to the details of the architectural elements. The composition captures the grandeur and craftsmanship typically found in historical European architecture.

artworks.title: Chateau de Chenonceau, 2e planche (The Chateau of Chenonceau, 2nd plate)
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon after Jacques Androuet Ducerceau I
artworks.description: The image shows a linear perspective view of the Château de Chenonceau. The castle is captured from a side angle with the structure extending over a river on a series of arches. The horizon aligns with the waterline beneath the bridge. The chateau's architectural features, including pointed towers and ornate windows, stand out against a blank sky. The etching technique uses precise and fine lines to depict the structure's details, shadows, and architectural elements clearly. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on black and white to define lines and shading. The river flows beneath the bridge's arches, and the chateau forms the main focal point with its windows, chimneys, and pinnacles.

artworks.title: Ancienne habitation à Bourges, dite "La Maison du Musicien" (An Old House at Bourges, Sometimes Called the "Musician's House")
artworks.medium: etching with graphite additions on wove Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene with an old building featuring a steep, thatched roof running diagonally across. The horizon is not visible, but chimneys and rooftops provide upward movement. The style uses fine, precise lines typical of etching capturing architectural details and textures. The color palette is sepia tones. Barrels and goods are displayed in the foreground with a seated shopkeeper. Figures are engaged in conversation further down the street, leading the eye toward rooftops and smoke rising from a chimney under a sky with dispersed cloud patterns.

artworks.title: La Rue des Toiles, à Bourges
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street in an urban setting with a narrow cobblestone lane lined with tall timber-framed buildings. The viewpoint is from ground level looking down the street towards an intersection. The tops of the buildings and sky dominate the upper area of the composition, with softly etched clouds visible. Some chimneys emit smoke. The artist's linework captures details of the architecture, creating a textured effect. The color palette includes shades of sepia and dark brown. In the distance, more architectural details and a slightly curved street flanked by historic structures are visible.

artworks.title: The Barc
artworks.description: The image shows a rowboat with figures, a ship with multiple sails in the distance, and rocky formations with a cave. Intricate strokes emphasize texture in the water and rocks. The monochromatic palette highlights contrasts and figures against the dynamic landscape.

artworks.title: Hieronymus Alexander, Archbishop of Brindisi
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person seated in a three-quarter view, looking slightly to their left. The individual is depicted with a serious expression, featuring prominent eyes and a slightly pointed nose, wearing a cap that covers most of their hair. They are dressed in a traditional garment resembling a cape or cloak, fastened with buttons down the front. Their left arm is bent, resting on the back of a chair, while their right hand holds a book and points to a specific location on it. A ring is visible on their right hand. In the background, a ledge holds a few closed books and a framed item with a simple geometric design on the front.

artworks.title: Pope Paul III
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing the upper half of a man's body. The man is left-facing with a downturned gaze. His facial features include a prominent nose, deep-set eye, and furrowed brow. He has a beard and hair covered by a cap or helmet. He wears a robe or cloak with textured folds. The background is shaded with cross-hatched lines. At the bottom, there is an inscription in a classical style that reads, "PAVLVS·III·PONT·MAX" with Roman numerals and letters for historical context.

artworks.title: Lucas Cranach
artworks.description: The image depicts a man facing slightly to the right, looking directly at the viewer. He has defined facial features with distinct cheekbones and deep-set eyes. The man has medium-length, neatly combed hair, along with a white beard that extends down to his chest in intricate curls. He is dressed in a dark textured garment with a high-collared shirt visible underneath. The background is a simple flat-tint surface.

artworks.title: Couple at a Table (Paar am Tisch)
artworks.description: The image displays a stylized portrayal of more than half of a person's body, focusing on their upper body and head. The person is shown in a seated position, with their body slightly turned and leaning over a table. Their facial features are depicted with exaggerated lines and angles, conveying a sense of sharpness in expression, and their hair appears dark and is rendered in loose, bold strokes. The person is unclothed and sitting with one arm resting on the table. There is a wine glass also depicted, and another face in the background. The background is filled with abstract, dark brush strokes that give a sense of depth and contrast to the bright yellow and black coloring of the image.

artworks.title: Cardinal Guido Bentivoglio
artworks.artist: Jean Morin, after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up. He is turned slightly to the left with his head tilted to the right. The man has a slender face with a prominent nose, arched eyebrows, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, short and receding hair. He is dressed in a buttoned, collared shirt with a cloak draped over his shoulders. The engraving is within an octagonal frame with inscriptions around it. The background is a simple, dark texture that contrasts with the lighter tones of his clothing and face, emphasizing his features.

artworks.title: Dom Jean Gregoire Tarrisse
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing towards the right side of the frame. His facial features include a prominent nose and chin, with fine lines on his face suggesting age. He is wearing a simple robe with a hood and the background has a textured pattern. The portrait is encased in an octagonal frame with text below identifying the subject.

artworks.title: Jerome Franck
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man. He is positioned facing forward with a neutral expression. The man has curly hair, a short beard, and a mustache. He is wearing period clothing with a high ruffled collar and a buttoned garment. The background is plain, and the portrait is framed by a polygonal frame. Below the portrait is an inscription with the name "Hiérôme Franque Peintre du Roy".
